summary: LUNAR-01 is an interactive 3D space mission simulation game developed using Roblox Studio for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project allows players to experience the exciting journey of planning, launching, and exploring a mission to the Moon. Players begin at a NASA inspired mission control center, launch a rocket, travel to the Moon, and explore the lunar surface. The game features a rocket launch system, lunar research facilities, low-gravity exploration, a lunar rover, rock sample collection, and a mission dashboard that tracks important resources such as oxygen, battery power and research progress.
details: LUNAR-01 is an interactive 3D Moon exploration and space mission simulation game developed using Roblox Studio. Our project aims to give players an engaging experience of participating in a NASA-inspired lunar mission while learning about space exploration, engineering, resource management, and scientific research.
